description: Quote-matcher regression set on the real rulebooks (git-ignored PDFs; games whose PDF is missing are skipped). Quotes are short passages the model wrote, or that earlier bench runs failed to match or locate. expect: continuous | fragments | partial | other_page | not_matched; located: the highlight has rects. Every located entry was hand-checked for the right place (see docs/m2-notes.md).
